papers.title_en: Multimodal Graph Retrieval-Augmented Sequential Recommendation via Collaborative Filtering Paths
papers.authors: Jason Marcell Setiadi, Xin Cao, Lina Yao
papers.evidence: 基于用户-物品图路径的多模态图检索增强序列推荐
papers.tldr: 多模态大模型在序列推荐中潜力大，但现有方法要么忽略邻居协同信号，要么因反复推理长历史而开销高。为此提出MGRASRec，以候选物品为条件从用户-物品交互图检索结构化路径，经多模态相似度扩展，将协同信号注入MLLM提示。该检索同时浮现最相关历史物品，免去循环摘要，每个候选仅一次前向推理。在三个公开数据集上，MGRASRec所有指标最佳，排序质量提升显著。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong potential for sequential recommendation through their ability to reason over complex multimodal data. However, existing approaches either rely solely on the target user's own interaction history, neglecting collaborative signals from neighboring users, or incur substantial computational overhead through repeated MLLM inference over long interaction histories. To address these challenges, we propose MGRASRec, a multimodal graph retrieval-augmented framework for sequential recommendation. MGRASRec injects collaborative filtering signals conditioned on the candidate item directly into the MLLM prompt by retrieving structured paths from a user-item interaction graph, extended via multimodal similarity to increase coverage beyond exact co-interaction overlap. This retrieval also surfaces the history items most relevant to the candidate at no additional cost, removing the need for recurrent summarization and keeping inference to a single forward pass per candidate. All components are unified into an augmented prompt for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of an MLLM. Extensive evaluations across three publicly available datasets validate the effectiveness of MGRASRec, achieving the best performance on all metrics with particularly strong gains in ranking quality.

papers.title_en: Beyond Sequences: Distilling Structured Decision Memory for LLM Recommendation
papers.authors: Leikun Liang, Guoshuai Wang, Xingsheng He, Yushan Han, Yunyi Xuan, Xiaoxiao Xu, Lin Qu
papers.evidence: 带结构化决策记忆的LLM推荐
papers.tldr: 现有LLM推荐多建模单一行为，或将多行为拍平成同质token序列，忽略决策语义层级，在相似商品的困难选择场景性能下降。MARI构建决策记忆库，通过事后决策蒸馏离线生成结构化决策记忆，记录目标、约束与权衡，并检索增强LLM推理。在下一项预测和新提出的困难选择预测任务上显著超越SOTA，且因解耦记忆构建与在线推理而保持低延迟。该工作提升可解释性与可扩展性，推动推理感知推荐。
papers.abstract_en: Despite the adoption of large language models (LLMs) in recommendation systems, prevailing approaches mostly model single-type behaviors (e.g., views or purchases). Even when incorporating multiple behaviors, existing methods flatten heterogeneous actions into homogeneous token sequences, ignoring their distinct decision-making roles. This flattening fails to capture semantic hierarchies and contextual nuances in complex decision-making, such as trade-offs between price and quality. Consequently, performance degrades in critical ``difficult-choice'' scenarios involving highly similar items. To bridge this gap, we propose MARI (Memory-Augmented Recommendation with Interpretability), which grounds predictions in explicit, structured decision evidence. MARI maintains a Decision Memory Bank (DMB) that archives users' past rationales as Structured Decision Memories (SDMs): concise records of goals, constraints, and trade-offs. These SDMs are generated offline via Post-Hoc Decision Distillation from heterogeneous behaviors and user-generated content. By retrieving relevant SDMs to augment LLM reasoning, MARI achieves interpretability and scalability without the prohibitive cost of processing long raw sequences. Extensive experiments show MARI significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on standard next-item prediction and a newly introduced Difficult Choice Prediction task, incurring low latency overhead by decoupling memory construction from online inference. Qualitative analyses reveal actionable, human-readable insights into user decision-making, marking a concrete step toward reasoning-aware recommendation systems.

papers.title_en: Rethinking Evidence Modeling: Context-Coupled Graph Learning for Multimodal Recommendation
papers.authors: Mingqiao Zhang, Qiyao Peng, Yumeng Wang, Wenzhe Dong, Hongtao Liu, Jian Yang
papers.evidence: 面向推荐的多模态图学习与上下文耦合
papers.tldr: 多模态图推荐将交互与图像文本视为语义-行为证据，但现有方法常将协同与语义关系分开聚合，证据难以跨层连续组合。本文提出 CC-MGRec，以上下文耦合图学习统一建模协同与语义关系，联合归一化协调消息尺度，并用推荐驱动的语义校准与逐层组合传播共享节点状态，隐式形成偏好证据链。在三个 Amazon 数据集上，推荐质量提升且图传播推理更快，为多模态证据建模提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal graph recommendation integrates observed interactions with item images and text to learn user preferences. These inputs constitute Semantic-Behavioral Evidence (SBE). Many existing graph methods incorporate collaborative and multimodal semantic relations, yet their aggregation and state updates remain context-separated, limiting the continuous composition of preference evidence across layers and the joint use of multiple sources. To address this limitation, we propose CC-MGRec, a context-coupled graph learning method that organizes SBE within a common graph learning context for cross-relation modeling and compositional propagation. Its context-coupled multimodal graph integrates user-item collaborative relations and item-item semantic relations, coordinating their message scales through joint normalization. Recommendation-grounded semantic calibration uses training behavior to adjust semantic neighbor weights while preserving normalized collaborative propagation coefficients. Collaborative-semantic compositional propagation updates shared node states layer by layer to continuously compose collaborative and multimodal semantic evidence, implicitly forming Preference Evidence Chains (PECs), including collaborative-semantic and visual-textual PECs. Joint execution of relation messages on the same shared node states within each layer preserves propagation outputs while reducing intermediate output processing and fusion overhead. We provide theoretical analysis of the proposed mechanisms. Experiments on three Amazon datasets demonstrate improved recommendation quality and faster inference during graph propagation.

papers.title_en: Tackling the Modality Inhibitance Effect with Wavelet-based Modality Integration in Multi-modal Recommendation
papers.authors: Rongqing Kenneth Ong, Andy W. H. Khong
papers.evidence: 多模态推荐中基于小波的模态整合与融合
papers.tldr: 多模态推荐从双模态扩展到三模态时常因新增模态的特定污染与信息冗余导致性能显著下降，即模态抑制效应。为此，作者提出多尺度模态小波推荐模型MMWave，通过小波分解从时频多尺度提取各模态非冗余关键特征。进一步设计结构感知多模态图学习与自适应模态调节器，以跨权重融合调控模态贡献。在四个真实数据集上验证了有效性，代码已开源。
papers.abstract_en: Harnessing rich modality features has recently gained prominence in multi-modal recommendation systems (MRSs). To delineate user modality preferences, existing works focus on modality fusion, which can be achieved via attentive summation or concatenation. In this work, we introduce the modality inhibitance effect - a phenomenon which limits existing MRSs when these models transit from dual-modal to tri-modal configurations resulting in significant performance degradation. In particular, apart from the modal-specific contamination encapsulated in the newly introduced modality, the inclusion of new features results in excessive informational redundancy, thereby severely impeding effective integration within current approaches. To address the modality inhibitance effect, we propose a new multi-scale modality wavelet (MMWave) multi-modal recommender, which aims to fully capitalize on essential modality features and suppress modal-specific noise. This is acheived by employing wavelet decomposition from a multi-scale (time \& frequency) perspective, ensuring that only essential (non-redundant) features of each modality are extracted. We then account for the latent associations between item modality features by designing a new structure-aware multi-modal graph learning module that captures high-order latent structural information pertaining to items. To modulate the relative contributions of modality features and achieve effective integration, we then propose a new adaptive modality regulator component that employs a new cross-weight integration strategy. Experiments conducted on four real-world datasets validate the efficacy of our proposed model. The source code for this work has been made publicly available at https://github.com/kennethorq/MMWave.

papers.title_en: Bridging the Topological Divide: Dual-Branch Graph Distillation with Semantic Priors for Robust Cold-Start Recommendation
papers.evidence: 结合双分支图蒸馏与语义先验的鲁棒冷启动推荐
papers.tldr: 图协同过滤在严格冷启动下因未观测物品拓扑孤立而出现表征坍塌，直接融合多模态语义又易与协同空间产生优化冲突。为此，作者提出双分支图知识蒸馏框架DualGCN：先以拓扑平滑语义先验构建协同教师，再让语义学生通过残差映射与余弦蒸馏对齐，并用动态范数重构校准检索尺度。三个真实数据集实验显示，该方法在冷启动场景显著优于SOTA，同时保持活跃物品推荐精度。
papers.abstract_en: Graph Collaborative Filtering models have achieved remarkable success in recommendation systems. However, they inherently suffer from a catastrophic representation collapse in strict cold-start scenarios due to the topological isolation of unobserved items. While integrating multi-modal semantic features offers a potential remedy, directly mapping isolated semantic attributes into a globally topology-driven collaborative space frequently precipitates representation degradation and optimization conflicts. To bridge this fundamental structural divide, we propose DualGCN, an innovative Dual-Branch Graph Knowledge Distillation Framework. Operating under a decoupled two-stage training paradigm, DualGCN first constructs a robust collaborative teacher network where item representations are anchored by a topology-smoothed semantic prior, effectively reshaping the latent manifold. Subsequently, a semantic student branch employs a residual mapping mechanism and a magnitude-agnostic cosine distillation objective to achieve high-fidelity cross-modal alignment without disrupting established collaborative signals. Furthermore, we introduce a dynamic norm reconstruction mechanism to rigorously calibrate the physical scales of novel and warm items during global retrieval. Extensive experiments across three real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that DualGCN significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in strict cold-start scenarios while comprehensively preserving recommendation accuracy for highly active items.

papers.authors: Chen Liang, Jinghui Li, Xiuze Zhou, Zongyue Wang, Yuanguo Lin, Han Yu
papers.evidence: 缓解冷启动的多模态推荐可解释性框架
papers.tldr: 多模态推荐系统借助异构信息缓解数据稀疏与冷启动，但跨模态表示和决策过程带来可解释性挑战，现有研究仍较零散。本文提出统一分析视角，按解释生成时机与方式将方法分为模态解释与事后解释，并为各类构建渐进式体系。同时从客观量化与主观感知归纳四类评估指标，并按应用领域和数据源梳理数据集。最后展望未来方向，为构建透明可信的多模态推荐系统提供研究基础。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal recommender systems effectively alleviate data sparsity and cold-start problems by integrating heterogeneous information, yet complex cross-modal representations and model decision-making processes also introduce new interpretability challenges. Despite the rapid growth of research on the interpretability of multimodal recommendation in recent years, relevant methods and evaluation criteria remain relatively fragmented, lacking a unified conceptual framework. To address this gap, this paper categorizes existing methods into modality explanation and post-hoc explanation based on the timing and manner of explanation generation, and further constructs a progressive system for each category. Building on this foundation, this paper synthesizes four categories of evaluation metrics from both objective quantitative and subjective perceptual perspectives, and reviews relevant datasets along the dimensions of application domain and data source. Through a comprehensive analysis of existing research, we further propose future research directions. This paper aims to establish a unified analytical perspective across multimodal representation, recommendation decision-making, and user preferences, providing a research foundation for building transparent and trustworthy multimodal recommender systems.

papers.title_en: Federated Semantic Residuals for Multimodal Recommendation
papers.authors: Zhiwei Li, Guodong Long, Chengqi Zhang, Jing Jiang
papers.evidence: 融合物品文本与图像的联邦多模态推荐
papers.tldr: 联邦推荐系统（FedRS）依赖协同分数排序，物品文本与图像可提供语义信息，但现有多模态联邦推荐（FedMR）将内容融合进模型，难以解释内容如何改变排序。为此提出语义残差适配器（SERA），把内容排除在原有FedRS外，仅叠加受边界约束的语义残差分数；当残差超过协同分差时，内容才能提升排名。实验表明，SERA在六个数据集上提升三种FedRS且不增加个性化参数，多数比较优于FedMR，甚至使部分FedRS超过集中式基线。
papers.abstract_en: Federated Recommendation Systems (FedRSs) learn collaborative scores from interaction histories on device and rank items by them, so a higher score means a higher rank. Item text and images add semantic information that can reorder the list. Existing Federated Multimodal Recommenders (FedMRs) fuse this content into their models, which can obscure how content reorders the list. We therefore propose the SEmantic Residual Adapter (SERA), which keeps content out of an existing FedRS and adds semantic residual scores to its collaborative scores. Content can then lift an item above another only when its semantic residual score exceeds the other's by more than their collaborative score gap. This score grows with the item's content similarity to the user's interaction history and is capped at a residual bound. We prove that for any content, an item can enter the list only if its collaborative score is within twice this bound of the lowest one in the list. A larger bound lets content lift more items, including irrelevant ones, so the bound trades off how far content reaches against accuracy. With a validated bound, SERA improves all three FedRSs on all six datasets without adding personalized parameters. It outperforms FedMRs in most comparisons and lifts some FedRSs above centralized baselines.

papers.title_en: Personalized LLM Recommendation with Semantic IDs: Autoregressive Beam Search vs. Multi-Token Prediction
papers.authors: Sejoon Oh, Fernando Amat Gil, Evan Smothers, Dan Iter, Mark Thornburg, Dawit Mureja Argaw, Sourabh Medapati, Thea Wang, Ria Verma, Qiuling Xu, Harshit Syal, Ehsan Gholami, Moumita Bhattacharya, Ashish Rastogi
papers.evidence: 基于LLM生成语义ID的个性化推荐器
papers.tldr: 大规模个性化正从嵌入表检索转向LLM推荐，模型直接生成物品的Semantic ID，每个SID由短层级离散内容码组成。传统方案用单头自回归加约束束搜索，新兴多token预测MTP则并行预测全部SID token以降低解码延迟。本文在工业级多任务LLM中做公平对比，并提出联合SID评分辅助排序损失来训练MTP。实验表明单头束搜索在排序与内容QA等产品关键指标上持续更优，Qwen3-8B规模训练成本约低2.6倍，MTP仅在原始推理吞吐上胜出。
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale personalization is shifting from embedding-table retrieval to LLM-based recommenders that generate the Semantic ID (SID) of the item to recommend, where each SID is a short sequence of discrete hierarchical content codes. A single instruction-tuned model can then unify retrieval, content understanding, and language, and recommend brand-new titles from their content alone using SID; then, how should the model generate the SID? Traditionally, models rely on a single language modeling head that generates tokens autoregressively, typically using constrained beam search. In contrast, an emerging body of work explores multi-token prediction (MTP), where dedicated heads predict all tokens in parallel, substantially reducing the decoding latency associated with beam search. We report an industry-scale, apples-to-apples comparison of these two generation paradigms: single-head autoregressive decoding vs. MTP. We introduce a new auxiliary ranking loss, defined over the joint SID score, to train the MTP objective. We evaluate the SID training objectives on both quality and training/inference cost, inside a multi-task LLM that jointly does personalized retrieval, content question-answering (QA), and instruction following over a large streaming-media catalog. Our experiments show single-head beam search consistently beats MTP on most product-critical metrics: ranking and content QA, and trains at roughly 2.6x lower dollar cost on Qwen3-8B scale; MTP wins only on raw inference throughput. Around this finding, we detail an efficient training and inference stack and report end-to-end gains over the previous non-SID baseline equipped with an auxiliary ranking head: +77% item cold-start ranking, +22% content-QA accuracy, +2.8x faster training, with language metric regression traced to SID vocabulary expansion. We address the language regression by reinforcement learning post training.

papers.title_en: OT-FlowRec: Optimal Transport-Guided Multi-Bridge Flow for Multimodal Sequential Recommendation
papers.evidence: 多模态序列推荐与多兴趣分布建模
papers.tldr: 多模态序列推荐中，用户兴趣在会话内动态演化且呈多中心并发分布，现有全局注意力方法易压缩历史并坍缩为单峰平均。针对此问题，OT-FlowRec提出最优传输引导的多桥流匹配框架，用并行兴趣专属传输流显式建模多兴趣分布，并设计几何传输与渐进时间采样预热策略，弥合连续分布拟合与top-k排序间的差距。在三个公开数据集上，该方法优于现有最先进基线，实现兴趣解耦并保留多峰偏好表示。
papers.abstract_en: E-commerce user preferences evolve dynamically within sessions, exhibiting concurrent and multi-centric interest distributions. While existing multimodal sequential recommendation methods leverage global attention to compress historical interactions, they inadequately capture the concurrent nature of multi-interest behaviors and fail to model the underlying multi-centric distribution of user intent. To tackle this issue, we propose OT-FlowRec, an optimal transport-guided multi-bridge flow matching framework that explicitly models multi-interest distributions to facilitate multimodal sequential recommendation. Unlike single-path generative models, OT-FlowRec constructs a mixture of parallel, interest-specific transport flows to model the multi-centric distribution characteristics, where each flow preserves a distinct user interest cluster via an optimal transport plan. Then, a geometric transport mechanism is designed to establish minimum-cost paths from the latent multi-interest distribution to target preference prototypes to provide multi-interest awareness. Moreover, a progressive time-sampling warmup strategy dynamically biases optimization weights toward the final states of the generation process, bridging the gap between continuous global distribution fitting and practical top-$k$ ranking metrics. This approach achieves explicit interest disentanglement, ensuring the preservation of a multi-peaked preference representation instead of collapsing it into a unimodal average. Extensive experiments on three public datasets demonstrate that OT-FlowRec outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines.

papers.title_en: Many Right Answers, One Training Example: Removing Responder Noise from GRPO for LLM Recommenders
papers.authors: Xin Li, Hao Jiang, Jinghao Guo, Weisi Lin, Chau Yuen
papers.evidence: 面向LLM推荐器的强化学习训练方法ReMaRk
papers.tldr: Reddit 推荐请求常有多条有效回复，Rank-GRPO 每次只随机选一条作奖励，优势信号多反映抽到哪条回复而非列表质量。ReMaRk 将每个生成列表一次性与所有回复标题的并集打分，并等概率采样每个请求，以去除响应者噪声并降低 RL 成本。在七个骨干和三个数据集上，它仅用 25%–53% 步数达到 2000 步逐回复 RL 的验证召回且领先；充分训练后也从未显著落后 Rank-GRPO。这表明面对多个有效人类答案时，应联合奖励而非随机选一个。
papers.abstract_en: A recommendation request on Reddit draws several replies, each naming different titles. When an LLM recommender is trained on such threads with reinforcement learning (RL), which replies should a generated list be rewarded against? The state-of-the-art recipe, Rank-GRPO, picks one reply per training example, so the advantage mostly records which reply was drawn (85% of its variance) rather than how good the list is. We argue that RL should train on the request, not on each answer, and propose ReMaRk: it scores every list once against the union of all replies' titles and samples each request equally. This makes RL cheaper. On seven backbones and three datasets, ReMaRk reaches the validation recall of 2,000 per-reply RL steps in 25 to 53% of the steps and leads at that budget; trained until neither improves, it is never significantly behind Rank-GRPO and in four of seven pairs reaches Rank-GRPO's best with fewer GPU-hours. The same reward helps on ProtoQA, where about 100 people answer each question, which points to a simple rule for RL with several valid human answers: reward them jointly.

papers.title_en: xLightGCN: Explainable Graph Neural Network Based Recommendation Systems with Most Influential Peers
papers.evidence: 基于图神经网络的可解释推荐与最有影响力邻居
papers.tldr: 推荐系统广泛用于社交网络，但许多现代模型如同黑箱，难以审计、理解与评估可信度。本文提出 xLightGCN，一种基于 LightGCN 类架构的精确图解释方法，为推荐决策生成解释，并识别最有影响力的同伴。该方法面向风险敏感的用户端 AI，提供可理解的解释，并从理论上保证解释保真度。其贡献在于为推荐系统建立可审计、可验证的信任机制提供路径。
papers.abstract_en: Recommendation systems, systems that predict a user's preference for items in order to curate that user's feed, are a ubiquitous and central feature in online social networks. While they are a central piece of our modern digital infrastructure, many modern approaches are opaque black boxes, making them difficult to audit, understand, and assess the trustworthiness of. In this paper we present an exact, graph-based approach for generating explanations for decisions made by recommendation systems. We argue that in the risk-sensitive sociotechnical context of user-facing AI such as recommendation systems, explainability is a key pillar for establishing the trustworthiness of models and validating their effectiveness. We propose a technique built on LightGCN like architectures, an influential and popular class of recommendation models. We describe our approach and argue that it provides an appropriate assurance mechanism for these AI systems leading to specific advantages, including interpretable explanations and a theoretically guaranteed measure of explanation fidelity. We conclude by discussing limitations and directions for future research.

papers.title_en: Personalization Matters: Long-Horizon Conversation Agent with User-Centric Information in Online Shopping Interactions
papers.authors: Rena Gao, Yue Dai, Hao Guan, Shengxiang Gao, Wangyang Wu, Yixin Shen, Jey Han Lau
papers.evidence: 基于大模型多智能体RAG的对话式购物推荐框架
papers.tldr: 在线购物对话需在多轮交互中保持偏好一致，但用户约束逐步揭示，现有方法依赖静态画像，难控长程行为。本文提出多智能体多模态RAG框架，解耦对话状态跟踪、推荐检索、偏好推理与回复生成，并融合商品元数据、评论、图像描述及历史评论。在Amazon Reviews 2023上，检索增强变体轨迹均值4.82，优于无RAG基线3.74；真实用户(n=5)中Full变体评分4.60，高于基线2.20。显示角色分解与用户中心检索能提升个性化长程交互质量。
papers.abstract_en: Personalized conversational shopping requires maintaining preference consistency over multi-turn interactions, where users reveal constraints gradually. Existing approaches often rely on static profiles and do not explicitly control long-horizon interaction behavior. We propose a multi-agent, multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework that decomposes dialogue state tracking, recommendation retrieval, preference-aware reasoning, and response generation, while integrating product metadata, product reviews, image-derived descriptions, and user historical reviews. To evaluate interaction-level quality, we adopt a trajectory-level protocol with four dimensions: Global Preference Consistency, Cumulative Information Synthesis, Interaction Trajectory, and Tone Consistency. On an Amazon Reviews 2023 benchmark, retrieval-enabled variants outperform a no-RAG baseline on automatic trajectory metrics (average 4.82 vs. 3.74). In a small real-user study ($n{=}5$), the Full variant achieves the highest mean overall rating (4.60 vs. 2.20 for Baseline), providing exploratory evidence that role decomposition plus user-centric retrieval improves perceived personalization.\footnote{Code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/RenaGao/Multimodel_RAG_Indexing

papers.title_en: Beyond Temporal Proximity: Explanatory World Models for Credit Assignment in Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Oriol Corcoll, Qiyao Wei, Ciarán Mark Gilligan-Lee
papers.evidence: 面向生成式推荐优化的强化学习信用分配
papers.tldr: 生成式推荐等长时程强化学习中，奖励常按时间邻近而非真实相关性传播，导致远距离关键动作信用衰减、样本效率低。为此提出解释性世界模型EWM，用大模型解释识别可能影响结果的早期事件，并以保守层级算子递归重分配奖励且保持回合回报不变。在Crafter、WordCraft、KuaiRand及工业推荐系统上，EWM优于PPO、LaRe、SFT、A2C等基线，延迟奖励越大增益越明显。结果表明，解释可为延迟结果提供结构化、可复用的信用分配信号。
papers.abstract_en: Generative Recommenders increasingly use Reinforcement Learning (RL) to optimize outcomes that may appear hundreds or thousands of interactions after a decision. Standard RL propagates reward according to temporal proximity rather than explicit relevance, attenuating the signal assigned to distant but important actions and creating a source of sample inefficiency. We introduce Explanatory World Models (EWM), an attribution framework that uses explanations to identify the earlier events that plausibly contributed to a realized outcome. We instantiate EWM with a frontier language model and use its explanations as learning signals using a conservative hierarchical operator that recursively redistributes reward while preserving the undiscounted episode return. To investigate what constitutes a useful explanation, we operationalize three complementary variants inspired by Halpern's actual causation, Lombrozo's explanatory simplicity, and Deutsch's hard-to-vary explanations. We evaluate EWM on two controlled long-horizon RL benchmarks, a public sequential-recommendation benchmark, and an industry-scale generative recommender. On Crafter and WordCraft, EWM substantially outperforms PPO and LaRe, with its largest gains when rewards are most delayed. On KuaiRand, EWM outperforms SFT and LaRe offline and A2C online. Finally, in an offline evaluation of an industry generative recommender, EWM considerably improves Recall and increases behavioral proxies. These results suggest that explanations can provide structured and reusable credit for learning from delayed outcomes.

papers.title_en: Vela: User Behavior as Supervision Sparks LLM Intelligence
papers.authors: Yang Xiao, Yusong Sun, Haoyi Wu, Wenyang Hui, Weiqiang Hang, Luqing Wang, Zejian Wang, Zirui Tu, Jingsheng Mao, Shaobo Hu, Yang Luo, Jiale Guo, Jin Zhang, Yudan Liu, Zhaokai Luo, Ren Huan, Yao Hu, Chengyue Jiang, Wenjie Li, Chuan Mu
papers.evidence: 以用户行为监督LLM用于推荐与意图推断
papers.tldr: 现有LLM多依赖静态文本或合成数据，难以从用户数周至数年的行为历史中推断偏好、意图与未来动作。Vela将真实用户行为转化为可训练任务与轨迹，从10万用户匿名记录生成覆盖91个模板的10万任务，并保留约7.5万条。微调Qwen3.6-35B-A3B后，用户相关任务最高提升11.5分，通用基准平均提升4分，表明真实行为是可扩展监督信号。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed in applications that act on users' long-term behavior histories, from personal assistants to recommendation and advertising systems. These applications demand the user dimension of LLM intelligence: inferring a person's preferences, intent, and likely future actions from weeks to years of behavior data. Yet current models are trained on static text or synthetic data, neither of which captures how user behavior evolves over time. Real-world behavior records, already available at scale on content platforms and in personal-assistant agents, offer a natural supervisory signal. We propose user behavior as supervision and introduce Vela, a framework that converts real user behavior data into trainable tasks and trajectories. From the anonymized behavior records of 100,000 users, Vela generates 100,000 tasks across 91 real-world task templates; difficulty-based filtering and trajectory acceptance criteria retain approximately 75,000 tasks with selected training trajectories. Fine-tuning Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on these trajectories improves performance over the base model by up to 11.5 points on user-related tasks and by an average of 4 points on general benchmarks. Training on more user behavior data further improves user-related performance, and reinforcement learning after fine-tuning outperforms reinforcement learning from the base model by up to 7.7 points. These gains suggest that real-world user behavior is a scalable source of supervision for both user-centered capabilities and the broader intelligence of LLMs.

papers.title_en: HASTE: Hierarchical and Attribute-aware Supervision for Generative Recommendation
papers.authors: Tripti Shukla, Shwetha Somasundaram, Akshat Gupta, Rohit Garg, Paul Duff, Ian Anderson
papers.evidence: 面向生成式推荐的层次化属性监督
papers.tldr: 生成式推荐把物品表示为语义ID并自回归生成，但现有方法只用标准因果交叉熵优化，未显式利用语义ID的层级结构，且长尾物品因监督不足表示较差。HASTE提出统一训练框架，引入层级损失与属性专属损失，分别在各层级提供监督并保留细粒度属性。在时尚推荐基准与Amazon多域数据集上，推荐性能全面提升，层级损失收敛速度约为标准目标的2倍。
papers.abstract_en: Generative recommendation models have shown promising results by representing items as semantic IDs and generating these IDs autoregressively. We introduce an approach showing that explicitly incorporating hierarchical and attribute-level supervision into generative recommendation can simultaneously improve training efficiency and long-tail recommendation performance. Existing approaches typically optimize semantic ID prediction with a standard causal cross-entropy objective, which does not explicitly exploit the hierarchical structure of semantic IDs and can require substantial training to learn effective item representations. Moreover, data-sparse tail items often suffer from poor representations due to limited supervision, resulting in weaker long-tail recommendation performance. We address these challenges with HASTE (Hierarchical and Attribute-aware Supervision for generaTive rEcommendation), a unified training framework that introduces hierarchical and attribute-specific supervision. HASTE's Hierarchical Loss explicitly exploits the multi-level structure of semantic IDs, providing supervision at each level of the item hierarchy and substantially accelerating training convergence. Its Attribute-Specific Losses encourage the model to preserve fine-grained item attributes, leveraging the language model's inherent semantic knowledge to improve representations and recommendations for tail items. We extensively evaluate HASTE on a fashion recommendation benchmark and across multiple domains of the Amazon dataset. HASTE improves recommendation performance across datasets and item-frequency regimes. Notably, the Hierarchical Loss achieves approximately 2x faster convergence than the standard causal cross-entropy objective, substantially improving training efficiency while maintaining strong recommendation quality.

papers.title_en: Training with Missed Targets in Generative Recommendation: Separating Supervision from Probability Competition
papers.authors: Xuesi Wang, Yangbin Shi, Xiaolin Zheng
papers.evidence: 面向生成式推荐中遗漏目标的训练策略
papers.tldr: 生成式推荐重排前只返回有限候选，可能漏掉已观测目标；训练时把这些漏掉目标追加进重排列表，会同时改变检索目标权重、增加监督并让两组目标竞争概率，简单追加/不追加对比无法解释返回项排序变化。作者构造三种匹配损失，固定检索目标权重，分别引入追加目标监督与组间概率竞争，其中间损失分组归一化、不让仅训练目标与推理候选竞争。实验显示这种竞争可能损害返回项排序，去除后 FT-NDCG 提升 7.8–22.2%。需要评估每个生成器是否采用候选补全，而非自动应用。
papers.abstract_en: Generative recommenders return a limited candidate set and may omit observed targets before reranking. A training strategy appends these missed targets to reranker training lists, although inference still ranks only original candidates. This operation simultaneously changes retrieved-target weight, adds supervision over appended targets, and makes the two groups compete for probability. An append/no-append comparison therefore cannot explain changes in returned-item rankings. We construct three matched losses that hold retrieved-target weight fixed while introducing appended-target supervision and group competition separately. The intermediate loss trains within both groups but normalizes them separately, preventing training-only targets from competing with inference candidates. Experiments with a released OneRec model and locally trained Amazon generators show that this competition can harm returned-item ranking. In four prespecified Amazon Video Games comparisons, removing it improved full-target normalized discounted cumulative gain (FT-NDCG) by 7.8--22.2\%; 95\% intervals over users and three of four intervals over training runs excluded zero. A conservative development-set rule selected appended-target training for two of three generators in one held-out category and rejected it for all three in another, avoiding a 1.7\% loss. Candidate completion should therefore be evaluated for each generator rather than applied automatically.

papers.title_en: Beyond Semantic IDs: Finite-Beam Reachability and Continuous-Query Generation in Generative Recommendation
papers.authors: Yu Sun, Renkai Xiang, Zuodong Xiang, Junwei Zhou, Yike Zhang, Jianxin Zhang, Zhihao Zhu, Xiaoyu Cao, Hailu Xu
papers.evidence: 面向生成式推荐的连续查询生成
papers.tldr: 生成式推荐常以有限宽度束搜索解码离散 Semantic ID 检索物品，该接口会限制目标进入有限返回列表。为此提出连续查询：CQG-Single 单次生成查询，CQG-AR 自回归生成连续残差，去除 SID 词表与离散束扩展。统一协议下，CQG-Single 七次运行均超 TIGER 式基线且参数仅 55.3%，CQG-AR 在 ML-1M 相当、在 Beauty 与 Sports 更强；并主张评估时解耦输出表示、建模与检索预算。
papers.abstract_en: Generative recommendation (GR) of social media platforms commonly retrieves items by autoregressively decoding discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) with finite-width beam search. This work examines how this output interface constrains whether held-out targets enter finite returned lists, while distinguishing catalog-wide scoreability from empirical top-K support. We introduce two continuous-query paradigms: CQG-Single generates one retrieval query in a single pass, and CQG-AR autoregressively generates continuous residual updates, retaining step-wise decoding while removing the SID item-token vocabulary, code lookup, and discrete beam expansion. These designs thereby eliminate the SID-specific reachability constraint induced by finite-beam decoding and avoid the technical challenge of aligning a discrete SID vocabulary with the pretrained backbone's vector space. Both methods make every encoded item directly scoreable through dense or approximate-nearest-neighbor retrieval. Under a unified protocol with valid-prefix constrained decoding, CQG-Single exceeds the TIGER-style baseline in all seven runs while using 55.3% as many trainable parameters. CQG-AR remains comparable on ML-1M and is numerically stronger on Beauty and Sports datasets. A controlled depth ablation further shows that additional continuous refinement does not monotonically improve shallow accuracy. These findings motivate decoupling output representation, autoregressive modeling, and retrieval budget when evaluating generative recommendation systems.

papers.title_en: LLM-based User-Product Relevance Evaluation for Dynamic Product Advertising
papers.authors: Wen Zhang, Xiao Bai, Hsiang-wei Chao, Mengfan Zhu, Tong Zhao, Mingxuan Ju, Xiaodong Liu, Congfei Zhang, Yunzhi Zhou, Yajun Wang, Jinchao Li, Yu Zhang
papers.evidence: 用意图代表评估广告推荐的相关性
papers.tldr: 动态商品广告（DPA）检索的离线评估受稀疏且偏置的反馈限制，在线评估又成本高。本文提出用户—商品相关性指标：先用语义ID分组与事件分层切分压缩用户互动历史为意图代表，再用LLM逐意图判断推荐商品相关性并聚合为用户级分数。为规模化计算，设计智能体式、对齐人工的提示框架生成多类别相关性准则，并将教师模型判断蒸馏到高效学生模型。该指标与离线及在线业务指标强相关，可在A/B测试前加速DPA检索迭代。
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic Product Advertising (DPA) retrieval systems are a core component of modern e-commerce advertising; however, their evaluation remains challenging. Conventional offline engagement metrics are limited by sparse, biased feedback, while online evaluation is costly and time-consuming. In this work, we propose a user--product relevance metric for offline evaluation of DPA retrieval systems. The metric first compresses the engagement history into a compact set of intent representatives via Semantic-ID-grouped, event-stratified segmentation, then assesses the relevance of a recommended product to each individual intent and aggregates them as a user-level relevance score, yielding a stable and interpretable measure of retrieval quality. To compute this metric at scale, we leverage large language models (LLMs) as semantic relevance judges, capturing nuanced functional and semantic relationships that heuristic methods often miss. We propose an agentic, human-aligned prompting framework that generates multi-category relevance guidelines and distills teacher-model judgments into an efficient student model for scalable evaluation. The resulting metric strongly correlates with offline and online business metrics, enabling faster and more reliable DPA retrieval iteration before A/B testing.

papers.title_en: UNISON: A Unified Framework for Learning from Scored Bags
papers.authors: Ofek Kirshenboim, Or Shkuri, Shani Finkelshtein, Yoram Louzoun
papers.evidence: 统一多示例学习与推荐系统的框架
papers.tldr: 多示例学习与推荐系统常被分开处理，但二者都可视为从带分数袋集合中学习。UNISON 统一框架将任务分解为通用物品表征、袋级偏好参数和袋级特征推断三阶段，并用一阶分析解释线性袋级评分。冷启动可化为闭式岭回归并具收敛保证。在图书、电影、TCR 分类和微生物组等多个领域任务上，它匹配或超越现有方法；合成实验显示袋级参数能恢复潜在评分因子，AUC 超过 0.998，且更高效可解释。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce UNISON, a unified framework that bridges multiple instance learning and recommendation systems by treating both as instances of learning from scored bag collections of (item, score) pairs. Unlike traditional approaches that address bag-level classification and personalized recommendation as separate problems, UNISON decomposes learning into three interconnected stages: (1) learning universal item representations, (2) modeling bag-specific preference patterns through lightweight personalized parameters, and (3) inferring bag-level characteristics from learned preferences. We justify the architectural choice of linear bag-specific scoring through a first-order analysis: when item embeddings are sufficiently smooth in the score, a linear function approximates the score up to a Taylor remainder controlled by the curvature of the underlying preference function. For cold-start scenarios, we show that the cold-bag fitting problem reduces to ridge-less linear regression with a closed-form solution, and provide convergence guarantees for the iterative variant. Empirically, UNISON matches or outperforms state-of-the-art approaches across diverse domains: entertainment (books, movies), immunology (T cell receptor (TCR) based classification), and microbiome, offering superior computational efficiency and interpretability. A controlled synthetic experiment further confirms that the bag-specific parameters ($w_j, b_j$) recover the latent factors that drive item scores even when the projection $φ$ has no access to the original scoring mechanism (AUC > 0.998). UNISON is available at https://github.com/louzounlab/UNISON.
